final_message:
Drafted the Rule 12(b)(6) memorandum for Crestline in Vogler v. Crestline (E.D. Tenn. No. 2:24-cv-00419). It seeks dismissal of all three counts with prejudice on five grounds: the agreements are non-exclusive, terminable discounts rather than exclusive dealing; the market is not plausibly defined; no monopoly power or specific intent is pleaded; no harm to competition is alleged; and there is no antitrust injury or standing, with AMP itself not suing. The file passed the docx validation script and parses back cleanly. The case citations are from memory and have not been cite-checked. The Table of Contents and Table of Authorities page numbers are estimates from a substitute-font rendering and need regenerating in Word. A clearly marked "Drafting Notes — Remove Before Filing" section at the end lists the facts kept out of the brief, errors in the internal research memo, the sealing issue for the attached Blue Ridgeway agreement, and the citations to verify.
